That registry still held one entry (Episode 1, script Ep1_...Final_v3.txt, status 'Script uploaded') which is why episodes were still showing. Copied here, then zeroed to [].
scriptUntouched: shows/crystal-bears/episodes/scripts/Ep1_The_Adventure_Begins_Final_v3.txt (578 lines) is NOT archived — re-adding the episode in the Studio picks it straight back up.

deliberatelyLeftALONE.cb-studio/data/projects.json: the PROJECT definitions (Crystal Bears' premise, style, audience, voice provider, music). Not episode content — deleting it would erase the show's own identity, not reset a run.
deliberatelyLeftALONE.projects/ep1-v2-archive/episodes.json: a saved ARCHIVE project from June. Clearing an archive's own index makes the archive unreachable, which costs history and buys a fresh run nothing. Left intact — say the word if you want it gone too.
